terms.privacy_policy_content:
# Dao Dao Privacy Policy

Dao Dao is committed to reshaping the nature of learning. We believe that learning should be self-directed, meaningful, and closely connected to the real world. In this rapidly changing era, we are building a learning ecosystem where everyone can continue to grow. Our registered users ("Members") share their learning experiences and learning resources, engage in learning exchanges with other Members, showcase their personal skills, experiences, and growth, publish and view related content, and look for potential opportunities for mutual growth and collaboration. Non-members ("Visitors") may view the content and materials of certain of our services.

This Privacy Policy exists between you and the administering authority of this Website, Dao Dao (https://daodao.so), hereinafter referred to as "this Website". Our Privacy Policy applies to any registered user or Visitor of our services.
Please read the following terms and conditions and confirm that, by uploading content to this Website, you agree to accept the contents of this agreement.

## Personal Data

After a Member logs in to the Website, Dao Dao obtains the Member's email address from third-party services such as Google and the application user ID, in order to distinguish between different accounts and contact Members. Publicly displayed information such as display name and avatar serves as the default avatar and display name on the Dao Dao learning community website.
Public information such as resources, practice topics, and responses newly added by Members after logging in, as well as the frequency of use of this platform, may be used by the Dao Dao team for data analysis. Once quantified or de-identified so that it is disconnected from the original identity, it may be retained as open data with the name removed for research or statistical purposes.
This Website strictly protects the privacy and personal data of Members, and will not, for any purpose, allow such data to be leaked to third parties unrelated to this service, except where the data has been sufficiently quantified or de-identified such that it is no longer considered personal data.

Members may change their default avatar, display name, and other social platform information on the Dao Dao website directly on their personal page, so that it no longer matches the public information on third-party services. In addition, Members may also email this Website's contact address (contact@daodao.so) to request the deletion or replacement of publicly displayed information or email addresses obtained from third-party services. This Website will, at the latest within thirty days after confirming receipt of the request, verify that the sender's email address is correct, and after confirming that the applicant is the original data subject, proceed with the deletion or replacement.

When you register an account, we may ask you to provide relevant information, such as your educational background, work experience, skills, photo, city, or region. Personal data information helps us provide you with more services. You may choose whether to include sensitive information in your profile and make that sensitive information public. Please do not post or add any personal data to your profile that you do not wish to make public.

## Third-Party Service Integration

To provide more complete features and services, this service may integrate with third-party platforms or services, including but not limited to Google services (such as calendar integration for scheduling learning time) and other social media or authentication services. When you choose to enable related integration features, you may authorize us to access, collect, and use certain information from your third-party services (such as account data, contacts, calendar events, etc.) in order to implement login verification, data synchronization, or other service features you require. We will only use this information for the purposes described in this policy after obtaining your explicit consent, and will strictly comply with the terms of use and restrictions of each third-party service. We only temporarily cache necessary information to provide the service, and do not permanently store your content; it is used solely to improve your learning experience.

### Special Notice on Google Services

When you connect Google Calendar, we access your calendar event information through a secure API, solely to help you schedule learning time and provide personalized learning recommendations. We will not share your Google data with other third parties, and you may revoke this authorization at any time in your settings. Our use of Google data fully complies with the Limited Use requirements of the Google API Services User Data Policy.

## Embedded Content from Other Websites

Articles on this website may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor had visited the other website. These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Information from Third-Party Sources

We may also obtain your information from other sources. For example, we may collect your information from third parties, including but not limited to mailing list providers and public sources. When you interact with our Members and online community on the service, we may collect any content or information that they choose to disclose or provide about you. We may also obtain your information from other sources, including but not limited to social media platforms, marketing partners, and other third parties. For example, if you link your social media account to your account, or create or log in to your account through a social media website, certain information from your social media account will be disclosed to us, which may include information from your profile or from the profiles of your friends.

## User Data Analysis

The Dao Dao platform uses artificial intelligence (AI) technology to optimize the user experience. To provide these features, we process user data, including learning activity records, resource interaction status, and content contributions. We will use anonymized and de-identified data to train and improve our AI systems. Before any data is used for AI training, personally identifiable information is removed. User-generated content, such as learning resources and discussions, may be analyzed by our AI systems to improve content recommendations and user interaction experience.

* AI-Generated Content
  AI-generated content on the Dao Dao platform may include:
- **Platform-generated content**: Content automatically generated by the Dao Dao platform's AI system, such as learning recommendations or review feedback. Such content will be clearly labeled by the platform as AI-generated to ensure transparency.
- **User-uploaded content**: Any content uploaded by users, whether or not created with the assistance of AI tools, is considered the user's original contribution. This platform currently cannot and will not proactively determine or label the manner in which user-uploaded content was created.

* AI Decision-Making Process
  Our platform may use AI to provide personalized learning paths and content recommendations. These recommendations are based on your learning behavior, interests, and goals.

* AI Safety and Transparency
  Dao Dao is committed to the responsible use of AI technology. We implement multiple measures to ensure that our AI systems are free of bias and avoid generating harmful content. We regularly evaluate and test our AI models and make adjustments based on user feedback. We are committed to transparently informing you of how AI features are used and their impact on your experience.

## How Long We Retain Your Data

If you leave a comment on this Website, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This allows us to recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue. For users who register on this Website, we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except for their username, which cannot be changed). Please note that website administrators can also view and edit this information.

## What Rights You Have Over Your Data

If you have an account on this Website, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data this Website holds about you, including any data you have provided to this Website. You can also request that this Website erase any personal data it holds about you. This does not include any data this Website is obligated to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

## Registration and Account Use

Regarding the registration and use of your Dao Dao Member account, you represent and warrant the following:

1. Users of this Website must be at least 16 years of age. When you complete registration or begin using the service, you are deemed to have fully reviewed, understood, and agreed to these Terms, and to have agreed to register as a Member and use the service.

about.vision_content_2: In this ecosystem, everyone is an independent yet interconnected learning island—simultaneously a creator of knowledge and a facilitator of learning. Through sharing experiences and exchanging wisdom, we weave together a learning network that supports one another, reshaping the learning life we love.

landing_page.feature_grid_section_subtitle: From learning pain points to a joyful experience — see every step of your growth
landing_page.feature_grid_item_0_description: Plan ahead, track progress, and reflect
landing_page.feature_grid_item_0_detail_0: Long-term plans or short-term sprints — take control of your learning pace
landing_page.feature_grid_item_0_detail_1: Track item progress and turn goals into action
landing_page.feature_grid_item_1_description: Share learning insights and find like-minded partners through discussion
landing_page.feature_grid_item_1_detail_0: Shell reactions to express gratitude and encourage sharing
landing_page.feature_grid_item_1_detail_1: All interactions are aimed at deepening understanding and promoting growth
landing_page.feature_grid_item_1_detail_2: Build learning connections — explore together, not compete
landing_page.feature_grid_item_2_description: Record every effort and make every breakthrough clearly visible
landing_page.feature_grid_item_2_detail_0: Learning records and activity display — see your growth trajectory
landing_page.feature_grid_item_2_detail_1: Personal skill map — visualize your personal development
landing_page.function_carousel_ribbon_alt: More features continuously evolving to bring a better learning life
landing_page.typewriter_bubble_tagline_1: Turn learning from a source of stress
landing_page.typewriter_bubble_tagline_2: into the most anticipated part of your day
landing_page.typewriter_line_3: Bring methods back to your plan
landing_page.function_card_description_0: Capture and share moments of inspiration. Here, every idea could light up someone else's learning path.
landing_page.function_card_description_1: Try a new topic for 7–30 days and discover your interests. Check in regularly and record your journey!
landing_page.function_card_description_2: Create a complete learning plan for important goals. Set targets, track progress, and accumulate growth!
landing_page.function_card_description_3: Explore quality resources recommended by the community, share great content you've used, and leave honest reviews.
landing_page.testimonial_0_content: I always gave up too quickly, but this time I used Daodao to practice 'daily illustration' and checked in for 14 consecutive days — the first time I felt I could actually stick with something...
landing_page.testimonial_1_content: I always wanted to practice English speaking and even bought courses, but didn't know where to start... On Daodao I set a daily progress goal and slowly built results (though I still slack off sometimes haha)
landing_page.testimonial_2_content: Coding had me questioning everything 🙃 But seeing others on Daodao working hard made me feel less alone. This platform has such a supportive vibe~~
landing_page.testimonial_3_content: I use Daodao to document every step of my career change — from skill lists to daily progress to reflections, all saved. I'm so excited thinking about sharing my journey with everyone!!!
landing_page.testimonial_4_content: Daodao lets me read and organize my thoughts at the same time, with image uploads — it's like keeping a learning journal ❤️
landing_page.testimonial_5_content: I'm a chronic procrastinator, but Daodao's 'check-in reminders' actually work. Seeing progress changes is like a game — I want to unlock every step.
landing_page.testimonial_6_content: Hard work should be seen by others, right~~ Being able to post and share learning here is amazing
landing_page.testimonial_7_content: I'm a go-with-the-flow type with serious commitment issues, and plans never stick for me — but Daodao made me feel for the first time that plans can be flexible and give you choices
landing_page.testimonial_8_content: I've been self-studying illustration on and off. This time I challenged myself to a 21-day image journal upload, and found so many treasures in Daodao's learning resources — speeding forward!! 🚀
